items.name: Barberton Mini 3 2024
items.information: This competition is taking place on a **Monday** night! Given the nature of the competition everyone **WILL** be expected to help out with judging, running, and scrambling. If you have any questions please ask before registering. Due to the size of the meeting room **PLEASE** limit the number of guests to 1 if possible. If time permits, we will add a 4x4 Final. There is a strict policy to leave the venue by 7:30 so we cannot make any promises.

items.name: Glasgow Favourites Evening II 2024

venue.name: Learning and Teaching Building, Strathclyde University

items.information: ## Please read the [Favourites Competition Format tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GlasgowFavEveningII2024#48994-favourites-competition-format) before registering. You are only able to register for a few of the events available at this competition. ##### Please be aware that this is an evening competition and does not begin until 5:20pm ### This competition will run in 2 groups. You will compete in one group and run, judge, or scramble for the other group. You MUST be present for the entirety of both groups (i.e. 5:20pm - 8:30pm) otherwise you will not be allowed to compete. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. [![Imgur](https://i.imgur.com/OXOffhf.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)
